text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing, we came 
across an Osaka specialty goods fair. 
Taking the opportunity to do some 
shopping...

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Here ya go! That'll be 3 million yen for 
the two!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Huh? Uh... three million, yen...

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you guys are so serious... I just 
blurted it out like I usually do. Sorry, 
sorry, for 300 yen—
Chuckle—did you say 3 million yen?!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ain't that real fancy, though. Must be 
that delicious, huh?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...! Oh, Lara-san.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Mind if I have one too? It'd be a waste 
not to eat such an impressive yakisoba 
pan."

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
"Much obliged, miss! Man, thanks to you, I 
didn't slip! Wahahaha!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... That was so funny. Just 
like—professional manzai comedians.
choice_data_list: Yeah, it was somehow really chic...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
No, no, sorry for meddling. It's a pretty 
common vibe back over there, you see.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Making someone smile is... a wonderful 
thing. Because it's so hard for me, I 
truly believe that.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"—I'm sorry. I couldn't come up with a 
witty reply on the spot."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Even though she... was just looking out 
for us, trying to make us smile...
choice_data_list: I couldn't even get a retort in...!

I couldn't bring myself to say anything 
either...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure—having a joke fall flat must feel 
really sad, right...?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to worry about it at all! 
You two really are so kind.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Still... to think ya'd show this much 
respect for Kansai's 'comedy spirit'..."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, I don't really know much about it 
myself, y'know? Hohoho...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, would you like to look around 
together? It must be fate that we ran into 
each other here."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"—I would love to. I'll do my best to be 
able to talk smoothly with shopkeepers, 
just like you, Lala-san."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
P-Please don't overdo it, okay? If you run 
into trouble, I'll figure something out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And then, when we went to an Osaka 
souvenir shop, we found a rice paddle with 
the logo on it."

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Little lady! I'll give ya a discount if ya 
buy two! Can't have a rally with just one, 
right~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Rally?

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Look at that ping-pong ball go, 
*clack-clack*!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: A ping-pong ball... Ah...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Wait, aren't these ping-pong paddles...?! 
No——rather than pointing it out, I should 
play along, like Lala-san did...!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I-Is it this one...? *Clack-clack*...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Hiyah--! Hiyah--!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Th-That Bouquet-chan is... P-Playing the 
fool...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Bouquetd'or kept doing her practice 
swings with all her might. The sight of 
her was truly—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
N-Now's your chance, Trainer...! Pick it 
up for her...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Really? Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'll do my best. Um—aiming for the 
Nationals!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Haa—haa—!
choice_data_list: Bouquet, I know you can win...!
Bouquet, I know you can win...!

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Wait, how long are you gonna keep this 
uuuup?!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Pfft-!

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
There's no straight man around to call 
this out?!! What in the world is this!?!? 
Has an endless rally of pure kindness just 
broken out~~~!?

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Gahahahaha! Ah, that was a good laugh! 
Alright, since you helped draw a crowd, 
I'll cut you a deal. How 'bout three for 
the price of one!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —Are you sure? Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—You have my utmost respect. To cause such 
an uproar of laughter...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Thank goodness—everyone smiled. Now we 
can all have matching ones. Rice paddles—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Did you say matching... gh...! Y-Yes... 
indeed."
choice_data_list:
This is that memorable shamoji from the 
three of you, huh…
This is all thanks to Lucky Lilac too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Indeed— Now I have a keepsake that will 
remind me of today every time I eat.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"—Heh... Yes, indeed. I'll gladly accept 
your offer."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes— Lala-san, thank you so very much.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"No, that's my line. A brand of comedy 
only you two could pull off... That was 
quite a treat to watch."
